title: Twin-Hawk Spear Mastery
summary: Teaches the elite spear user to strike like a pair of hawks hunting together, one high and one low.

title: Azure Tassel Spear Canon
summary: A canon of the elite spear in which the tasselled shaft is spun to hide the point and mislead the eye.

title: Basin-Floor Spear Strategies
summary: Sets out how to fight low and wide on level ground, using the basin's floor as a stage for the long spear.

title: The River-Mouth Spear Discourse
summary: A discourse on the spear where many small streams of qi join into one powerful flow at the point.

title: Dual-Track Reach: The Skilled Spear in Two Currents
summary: Combines a long track of the arms and a short track of the body so the point strikes from either distance.

title: Hawk-Wing Haft Forms of the High Azure
summary: Treats the haft as the wing of the spear, broad in sweep and quick to turn, with strikes from its length.

title: Confluence Spear Book of the Twin Rivers
summary: Uses the image of two rivers meeting to train two spear users, or one, in strikes that join at a single point.

title: Court of Two Points: The Elite Spear Syllabus
summary: An elite syllabus on holding two points of attention at once, the opponent's spear and the opponent's feet.

title: Wind-Sworn Spear Mastery on the Plateau
summary: Gives the elite wind-sworn spear user the habits of long marches and exposed ground, with a point as steady as a post.

title: Gale Oath Spear Canon
summary: A canon of the oath sworn into the spear, which binds the user to finish each thrust as the wind finishes its run.

title: Bearing and Thrust: An Elite Spear Syllabus
summary: An elite syllabus on keeping the body's bearing true through a thrust, whatever the ground or the wind.

title: The Edge-Walker's Spear Discourse
summary: A discourse on fighting on narrow ground, with a ridge or a cliff edge beside the spear user.

title: No-Walls Spear Book of the Long Wind
summary: A book for the spear user who trusts only the open ground and the wind, with every line left open to the horizon.

title: Crosswind Haft Forms of the High Plateau
summary: Gives forms in which the haft is held across the wind and used as a lever against heavy blows.

title: Spear Oaths Sworn Into the Wind
summary: Teaches a series of sworn thrusts each tied to a plain oath, so that the spear user's purpose steadies the point.

title: The Gale-Bound Point: Elite Forms
summary: Binds the point to the gale so that the thrust gathers speed along its length and arrives with the wind behind it.
